## Links

<!-- Every PR closes an issue: `Closes #<n>` (except trivial no-behavior fixes — typo, comment, formatting, dead link — per AGENTS.md §10). Behavior changes also link the spec section this PR lands — the first PR of a feature issue lands spec + implementation together. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Tests or other deterministic evidence. Bug fixes add a regression test where the project has tests. -->

- [ ] Tests/fixtures added or updated for the changed behavior
- [ ] Spec or docs updated in the same pull request when behavior changed
- [ ] No real financial data, account numbers, or secrets in code, fixtures, or screenshots
